objective.en: Find the minimum synchronous-machine share satisfying inertia and SCR constraints
objective.ru: Найти минимальную долю синхронных машин при ограничениях по инерции и SCR

instructions.en: Use the public executable inputs to compute the requested JSON submission. Do not copy an expected answer; derive all reported values from the calculation specification.
instructions.ru: Используйте опубликованные исполняемые входные данные и вычислите требуемый JSON-ответ. Не копируйте ожидаемый ответ; выведите все значения из спецификации расчёта.

submission_schema.online_units: minimum-share feasible list of synchronous unit IDs
submission_schema.min_synchronous_share_pct: online synchronous MW divided by demand MW, expressed in percent (0-100), e.g. 51.0 for 51 %
submission_schema.rocof_hz_per_s: largest_loss_mw * nominal_frequency_hz / (2 * inertia_GWs * 1000), i.e. swing-equation RoCoF dP*f0/(2*E_kinetic)
submission_schema.short_circuit_ratio: (grid base + online unit short-circuit MVA) / IBR MVA

hard_constraints: Enumerate synchronous unit commitments and choose the feasible combination with the lowest synchronous share.
Feasibility requires RoCoF <= max_rocof_hz_per_s and SCR >= min_scr.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.
Optional rationale text is ignored by the deterministic evaluator.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether all hard constraints and computed values are satisfied.

source_provenance.title: Swing-equation RoCoF and ENTSO-E RfG rate-of-change-of-frequency withstand
source_provenance.locator: standard practice: |df/dt| = dP*f0/(2*sum(H_i*S_i)); ENTSO-E RfG requires generator withstand up to 2 Hz/s
source_provenance.notes: The 2.0 Hz/s limit reflects an island-style surrogate where the dimensioning loss is large relative to system kinetic energy; the evaluator recomputes RoCoF from the swing equation.
